claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic runs from March 5–17, 2026.
Miami hosts the championship of the 2026 World Baseball Classic on March 17, 2026.
LoanDepot park in Miami, Florida hosts Pool D, Quarterfinals, Semifinals, and Final of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Daikin Park in Houston, Texas hosts Pool B and Quarterfinals of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan hosts Pool C of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Hiram Bithorn Stadium in San Juan, Puerto Rico hosts Pool A of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Top teams from pool play in San Juan, Puerto Rico and Tokyo, Japan advance to the quarterfinals in Houston, Texas and Miami, Florida for the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
